GAP_CLASSIFICATION: ac_amendment CATEGORY: implicit_assumption
FINDING: Verify protocol-doc sub-section path resolves before referencing from agent file.
AC AMENDMENT: Before embedding the pointer to the per-agent schema-preservation sub-section in approach-proposer.md, Read the candidate protocol doc paths (plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md and plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md) to find the actual resolved path. If neither exists, fail the task with a clear error. The embedded pointer must use the real resolved path, not a guessed one.
VERIFY: The path embedded in the DELTA OUTPUT MODE stub (referencing remediation-loop-protocol.md) matches the actual on-disk location — Verify: grep -E 'remediation-loop-protocol' plugins/dso/agents/approach-proposer.md | head -1 | grep -qf <(ls plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md 2>/dev/null | sed 's|.*/||')
